description: List every rubric defined in a course, returning each rubric's title, points_possible, and criteria/ratings. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use get_rubric to fetch one rubric by ID once you have it, get_rubric_assessment for a specific student's completed assessment rather than the rubric definition, or create_rubric to add a new one. Requires the manage_rubrics permission in the course, so most students cannot call this.
name: list_rubrics
title: List Rubrics
